_meta.basis: User-supplied context response on 19 September; identity anonymised
_meta.current_example: contexts.current_context preserves the current shape; it has no billing extension
_meta.proposal: Other contexts add subscription.billing and populate existing subscription.trial_ends_at, price and trial_days
_meta.money_units: Rupees for INR, matching subscription.monthly_price; convert to paise only at the payment boundary
_meta.time: Proposed responses require an explicit timezone on timestamp and all billing dates; current_context deliberately preserves its missing offset
_meta.provider_ids: All mock_* IDs/signatures are invalid for actual Razorpay Checkout
_meta.authority: Synthetic UI/test states; no real entitlement, verification, cancellation or refund
